title: Where One Is Upto?
author: Manas Bakshi
text:
River water
In quest of a friendly estuary
Comes across
A mossy rock,

Whispers a language
Strange as darkness
Conveying an appeal
To buzz with
Hedonic togetherness --

A golden paddyfield
Or, a lonesome island
Brewing in front
Or, looming from behind
Makes no difference
In the world of Nature....

It does at the other end
Where humanbeings
Play time-suited games
Craving for
A wish-fulfilling river to ride,

Born with
The dulcet music of life
Lose it in the web
Of petty ego and pride --

Outer space
Ravaged by intolerance
Spreading like wild fire
In a dry forest ....

How far can AI advance
To unearth one`s inmost self ?

Inner space
Wailing for silence of solitude
In the heart of Amazon rainforest
Where`s shrinking fast
The rhythm of life urbanised !

Where`s one upto
Failing everywhere
To leave a trace
To be content from within ?
stanzas: In quest of a friendly estuary
It does at the other end
In the heart of Amazon rainforest
